title: No Attack Cooldown
description: basically this plugin gets rid of the minecraft 1.9 attack cooldown.
body: this plugin just removes the minecraft 1.9 attack cooldown from the pvp system. it has a toggle to re enable 1.9 pvp in a specific world tho and uses a config file for simple configuring, theres still an ingame command to configure it tho, this applies it instantly.
